text: Expected value: less restart work, reusable capabilities, independent experimentation and better use of limited compute.

name: quote
text:
“You can’t just tell them something

name: quote attribution
text: Andrej Karpathy, October 17, 2025

name: takeaway text
text: Persistent lab state supports continuity. It does not solve continual learning in model weights.

Main slide 1. Goal comes before topology. The lab operating model supports long-running independent research and safe local evolution. Improvements remain candidates until checked. Contributions to central AI4R and upstream OpenJiuwen are separate. Intended benefits require measurement.
Quote exactly from Andrej Karpathy at 00:00:07–00:01:44 in the publisher transcript, https://www.dwarkesh.com/p/andrej-karpathy . The quote motivates external continuity; we do not claim that saving project state solves his wider continual-learning concern. No endorsement is implied. The research brief supplies objectives and limits, not a one-pass task script.

text: Other lab VMs repeat this structure with separate versions, writable state and scoped access.

Main slide 2. VM per lab remains selected; option A supplied visual style only. Each VM contains the full lab-owned AI4R and its subsystems. People are plural and may collaborate in a lab. Primary interaction is the lab UI, not a super-level research runtime. A stable VM-local supervisor controls Engine access. JiuwenBox is reused selectively for compatible tool/job lifecycle, not treated as the OCI carrier or hypervisor. Read-only images may be shared but writes and credentials are scoped. External services connect over authenticated endpoints and may be remote. Private model execution is detailed on slide 8. The Engine/supervisor and VM control have narrow responsibilities. Guest administrators can override internal protections; agents have narrower rights.

Main slide 3. The brief represents current accepted direction and constraints. Findings/hypotheses update knowledge; observations do not silently become human requirements. Planning revisits strategy and ready work. Research includes Search, Hypothesis, Screening, Builder, Benchmark, Scientific Evaluation and Delivery, with concrete capsule choices determined by the lab. Checking spans preparation, execution and candidate qualification, with selected review payload boundaries preserved. Knowledge and local catalog state are durable. The factory produces CC candidates; RSI owns improvement search including harness candidates. All subsystems are lab-local versions. Eligible capabilities enter future bindings. Existing invocations keep their pins. Graphs show responsibility/data flows; detailed interfaces need specification.

name: title
text: Research is a continuing cycle

name: subtitle
text: The brief gives direction. Findings, failures and opportunities change the next investigation.

name: source
text: Proposed M2 cycle. Existing M1 frozen plans do not yet implement this entire research loop. Evidence: 12–16.

name: goals
text:
Goals and constraints
Brief + unresolved questions

name: strategy
text:
Choose / revise strategy
Hypotheses and useful work

name: run
text:
Run ready experiments
Independent work can overlap

name: observe
text:
Check and observe
Results, failures, uncertainty

name: learn
text:
Learn and retain
Evidence changes understanding

name: adjust
text:
Adapt the next work
Retry, repair or change method

name: local retry
text:
Local retries stay inside their
assigned scope and total budget

name: takeaway text
text: Continue until supported completion, a real blocker, a human pause or the resource limit.

Main slide 4. This is a recurrent research process, not a list of singular tasks completed once in order. Goals persist across sessions. Local specialists can retry, repair and adjust methods within their assignment. Material discoveries, requirements changes, failed prerequisites or no progress can revise strategy. Only justified near-term work gets dispatched; many independent ready jobs may overlap. A failed attempt is retained rather than relabeled success. Accepted negative/inconclusive science can advance research. Strong checking and bounded cumulative spending remain in the loop. User permissions stay authoritative. A human changes scope/completion criteria; producer suggestions do not rewrite them. New capabilities become options for future work. Persistent state supports restarting the cycle without reconstructing it from chat.

text: A stateful application can persist while research invocations come and go

name: takeaway text
text: Resource limits and exclusive leases serialize conflicting work. Parallelism is not unlimited.

Main slide 5. Horizontal position shows a conceptual progression, not elapsed-time data. Branch A can repair a failed invocation while branch B continues. The application may be a simulator, database or other long-lived service. Stateful mutable sessions need exclusive leases. A new method/capsule does not replace an active binding. A change invalidating shared premises escalates to project-level planning; local source selection or tool repair can remain scoped. Work can stop or wait with visible reasons. Cross-batch accepted artifact transfer and safe concurrent revision are specific M2 integration work, not implicit features of a generic agent loop.

text: Model endpoints, credentials and large datasets are declared resources, not duplicated in every image.

Main slide 6. Containerized capabilities vendor software dependencies and tool implementations. Packages may expose multiple related operations and may bind a long-lived application service. Immutable package identity differs from an invocation, output artifact and mutable service instance. Required data/weights are separately pinned resources; secrets are enrolled outside images. Import/build alone is not admission. Factory candidates and RSI harness changes retain their independent qualification path. Compatible locally admitted updates may be eligible for future bindings; active work and sessions retain pins. Shared image/library infrastructure may be remote. Engine authority stays with stable supervision, not generated code. No universal remote reproducibility follows from an OCI image.

name: subtitle

name: source

text: API calls

name: response
text: Responses return to the requesting lab

name: placement
text: Same machine or remote host

name: openness
text: The model server can change behind a supported interface. Tool calling, streaming and context limits still need compatibility checks.

name: takeaway text
text: Shared workers reduce duplicate model allocations. Quotas, queues and deadlines handle contention.

Main slide 7. The mental model is a normal model-serving API, even when model weights are hosted locally in our infrastructure. This decouples a lab from model placement and permits multiple supported backends. An endpoint profile includes base URL, protocol/features, model/version, scoped credential reference, timeout and budget. OpenAI-compatible chat is a concrete interface candidate, not an assertion that every provider implements identical tool, response, context or streaming semantics. The chosen model adapter is the compatibility boundary. The profile box is logical configuration and does not require a new gateway service.
Shared inference has finite GPU memory and throughput; schedule requests with per-lab limits and service-side admission/queues. Do not silently fall back to another model if unavailable; wait/fail visibly according to the invocation profile. Sharing avoids one dedicated server/weight allocation per lab, but savings and capacity require measurements. Request KV caches and quotas still cost resources. Inference credentials and research data have scoped access. Shared inference is not a permission to see another lab’s projects, logs or private models. A lab stop cancels its requests where supported without stopping the shared server.
https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/serving/online_serving/openai_compatible_server/ ; official server interface documentation, accessed October 27, 2026. API compatibility is endpoint/model-feature-specific.

name: takeaway text
text: Reserve scarce compute for training. A private model does not become a shared endpoint automatically.

Main slide 8. This is a private model workload, not a change to the default shared-inference service. Fine-tuning can mutate lab-owned weight/checkpoint copies. No other sandbox may call the private endpoint or read its weights/checkpoints. Enforce lab-scoped network policy, bind addresses and authorization, not only a hostname convention. Do not register it with shared gateways or service discovery. Operator administration and explicit export are distinct from sandbox access. Any future sharing requires a separate explicit promotion decision; nothing automatically opens cross-lab access. A private experiment can still use authorized shared inference as an external tool, but that shared endpoint is not its private model.
The lab needs an allocated compute/device route. VM ownership alone does not give it a GPU. If the selected VM provider cannot expose the required accelerator, mark that profile unavailable until a separately qualified lab-exclusive execution binding is designed. Do not claim Spark guest GPU passthrough. Memory, storage, checkpoint staging and GPU reservations count against real capacity. Training jobs may need exclusivity to protect other labs and valid comparisons. No new training framework is selected by this diagram.

title: Persistent data survives experiment and runtime replacement

name: title
text: Persistent data survives experiment and runtime replacement

name: subtitle
text: Stopping compute preserves the project. Restart verifies state before continuing the research cycle.

name: source
text: Designed lifecycle. Actual termination, external power-off, backup and restore remain acceptance tests.

name: research

Pause research
Stop new dispatch

name: experiment

Cancel an experiment
Supervisor stops owned processes

name: labstop

Stop lab compute
Preserve durable data

name: outside
text:
Emergency VM stop
Host / provider authority

name: data

Persistent lab data
Goals, knowledge, artifacts, jobs, source, checkpoints

name: restore
text: Restart / restore: fence the old writer, reconcile jobs, validate state

name: delete
text:
Deletion is separate
Shared inference and other labs

name: takeaway text
text: The stop path must remain usable when the agent hangs. Unknown external effects need reconciliation.

Main slide 9. Pause stops dispatch; it does not mean compute is released. Supervisor cancellation requests termination, escalates within a configured bound, then verifies process/job status. Normal lab stop quiesces/cancels owned work, stops local services and preserves project data. Independent host/provider control can force-stop the VM if guest control hangs. Force power-off is not an application-consistent checkpoint. Reconcile incomplete work at restart; do not silently replay external effects. Separate explicit deletion decides data disposition. TTL/idle policies may not delete unique project state.
Persistent volume placement, independent backup destination and restoration are concrete deployment inputs. Backup consistency and old-writer fencing are necessary. A copied simulator volume does not recreate live physics state unless the application supports it. Shared inference remains available when one lab stops. Human guest administration may override protections; no claim of tamper-proof evidence against the lab owner.
https://libvirt.org/manpages/virsh.html ; shutdown and destroy/power-off are distinct from storage deletion. Provider support must be qualified.

title: The stack follows the lab’s responsibilities

name: title
text: The stack follows the lab’s responsibilities

name: subtitle
text: Reuse compatible components and keep AI4R’s research and qualification decisions under our control

name: source
text: Selected direction with explicit qualifications. No platform installation or integrated runtime validation is claimed.

name: takeaway text
text: First proof: continue a research cycle, reuse a CC, stop a runaway job and recover its retained project.

Main slide 10. The stack is concrete at the responsibility/interface level. Exact host/provider, image pins, GPU allocation and model server are deployment qualifications, not fabricated current installations. Reuse OpenJiuwen where it preserves our contracts. JiuwenBox handles compatible sandbox/tool operations and may inform lifecycle adapters; it is not the whole VM manager or generic OCI engine. Existing native interfaces guide compatibility tests. Keep AI4R-specific packages, artifact transfer, independent qualification and research revisions under our ownership. Coder is an optional later workspace-access evaluation, not the selected research control plane.
First demonstrator has recurring research with at least one material revision, concurrent independent work where supported, a package import/qualification/invocation, shared endpoint requests with per-lab limits, private model access denial from another lab, actual job stop and independent VM stop, then retained-state continuation. Controlled drivers are distinguished from autonomous decisions. Measure useful outcomes, restart cost, total model/checking cost, resources and isolation failures. No benchmark gain is assumed.

title: Acceptance scenarios before claiming the design works

name: title
text: Acceptance scenarios before claiming the design works

name: subtitle
text: Tests target recurring research, real shutdown and the shared/private model boundaries.

name: source
text: Proposed checks. None is marked passed by this presentation or by the existence of these diagrams.

Failure scenarios include unavailable endpoint with no silent model substitution, missing GPU route, exhausted disk, corrupt backup, missing accepted input, failed qualification, stale plan revision and process interruption. A visible blocker or supported scientific negative can be valid. Protected acceptance and budget exits are not bypassed by the research loop. Runtime demonstrations must name exact versions, configurations and observed outcomes. Short trials establish bounded feasibility, not general day-long autonomy or scientific correctness.
